Re:Zero−Starting Life in Another World Vols 1-28 Light Novel English Version-DHL KINDLY CHOOSE YOUR VARIATION VOL 1-12 (HALF SET-12 BOOKS) VOL 13-25 (HALF SET-13 BOOKS) VOL 1-27 Update Synopsis Subaru Natsuki's ordinary life is turned upside down when he is mysteriously transported from a convenience store into a dangerous fantasy world. Soon after his arrival, the bewildered teenager is violently attacked by a group of thugs. Armed only with a bag of groceries and a now useless phone, Subaru is quickly overpowered and left battered. Just as things seem hopeless, a mysterious girl named Satella, in pursuit of a thief who stole her insignia, arrives and saves him. Grateful for her kindness, Subaru offers to help Satella in her quest. That night, he manages to find the thief's location, but little do they know, a much darker force is quietly observing them from the shadows. In a shocking twist, after they retrieve the insignia, both Subaru and Satella are brutally murdered. But just as Subaru faces his death, he inexplicably wakes up in the same spot, only to relive the entire sequence of events once again, encountering the same thugs and Satella. As Subaru's repeated deaths unfold, he begins to realize that something far more sinister is at play—forcing him to confront a mystery that might hold the key to escaping the endless cycle.

description: ARE THERE MAIDS IN HEAVEN? A summer vacation filled with love has come to an end as Amane and Mahiru head back to school. They re still floating on cloud nine, and their classmates can tell. If anything, it s too obvious, and they wish these lovebirds could stop smothering the classroom with their overpowering romance. If they have to fill it with something, then it should be maids or so the votes say when they decide to run a maid cafe for the fast-approaching cultural festival. Amane isn t super-excited about the prospect of random guys ogling Mahiru for days, and while that s a real concern, he should actually be worrying about what he ll have to do during the event!

description: DESCRIPTION: Too Many Losing Heroines! Light Novel (Vol 1-6) 🔥 Each volume sell separately and the price is for one Volume. 🔥 The product is a reproduction copy. Synopsis: Too Many Losing Heroines! follows Kazuhiko Nukumizu, a quiet high school student who prefers observing people rather than getting involved in their drama. One day, he accidentally witnesses a popular girl from his class getting rejected by the boy she likes. That moment leads Kazuhiko to unexpectedly become involved with several girls who have one thing in common — they are all “losing heroines,” girls who fail to win the hearts of the boys they like. As he gets pulled into their complicated romantic situations, Kazuhiko finds himself supporting them through heartbreak, misunderstandings, and the awkward moments that follow rejection. What begins as simple observations slowly turns into unusual friendships, emotional growth, and a comedic look at the side characters who usually lose in typical romance stories. description: TRIPLEASTORES 86 EIGHTY SIX Light Novel Full Set Vol 1 - Vol 12 English Version Book Novel Product Description Synopsis : The Republic of San Magnolia has been at war with the Giadian Empire for nine long years. In the early stages, the Republic suffered devastating losses against the Empire’s autonomous mechanized army, known as the Legion . However, it eventually developed its own unmanned combat machines, called Juggernauts , which are remotely directed by military operators known as Handlers . To the public, the war appears to be fought entirely between machines. In reality, the Juggernauts are piloted by human soldiers—specifically the Eighty-Six , a marginalized minority group officially known as the Colorata . Once equal citizens alongside the dominant Alba race, the Colorata were stripped of their rights, branded as subhuman, and forced into internment camps within the Eighty-Sixth Sector . There, they are coerced into fighting the Republic’s war under the false promise of restoring their families’ citizenship. Among the Republic’s officers is Major Vladilena “Lena” Milizé , a young Alba noblewoman who serves as the Handler of the elite Spearhead Squadron —a unit of battle-hardened Eighty-Six soldiers who have earned the right to bear names. Their field commander, Shinei “Undertaker” Nouzen , leads the squad with quiet resolve. The Spearhead Squadron is infamous throughout the military, as many of their previous Handlers have succumbed to psychological breakdowns or taken their own lives. As Lena begins working with Shinei and his squad, she grows increasingly aware of the injustices they face and becomes determined to help them. Together, they uncover a harrowing truth: the Republic and its so-called war for survival are not what they appear to be. description:
86: EIGHTY SIX Light Novel Series Volumes 1–13 English Edition by Asato Asato (FREE EXPRESS SHIP) General : 86: Eighty Six (Japanese: 86 エイティシックス-, Eiti Shikkusu ) is a Japanese science fiction light novel series written by Asato Asato and illustrated by Shirabii. It has been published by ASCII Media Works under the Dengeki Bunko imprint since February 2017 and is licensed for English release in North America by Yen Press. The series inspired a manga adaptation illustrated by Motoki Yoshihara, which ran in Square Enix’s Young Gangan magazine from February 2018 to June 2021. Additionally, three spin-off manga were created: 86: Operation High School and 86: Mahō Shōjo Regina Lena Tatakae! Ginga Kōkō Senkan San Magnolia , both by Suzume Somemiya, and 86: Fragmental Neoteny . These were serialized across different periods in Monthly Comic Alive magazine by Media Factory. An anime adaptation by A 1 Pictures aired from April 2021 to March 2022,
 further boosting the series' popularity. While “86” might sound like a 
code or historical reference, in this context, it represents a gripping 
sci fiction tale set in a fictional world, and the number has no direct 
connection to any real-world country or historical event. Plot : The Republic of San Magnolia has been locked in a nine-year war against the Empire of Giad. Though initially overwhelmed by the Empire’s fully autonomous robotic forces known as the Legions, the Republic eventually introduced its own unmanned units, called Juggernauts, supposedly operated remotely by military "Handlers." To the public, it appears to be a war fought entirely by machines but the truth is far more disturbing. Behind the scenes, the Juggernauts are actually piloted by real people specifically, members of the oppressed Colorata minority, labeled as "86." Once equal citizens, the Colorata were stripped of their rights and dehumanized by the dominant Alba race, sanctioned by the Republic’s supremacist regime. Branded subhuman, denied personal names, and confined to internment camps in the so called 86th District, these individuals are forced to fight on the frontlines in exchange for the bare promise of humane treatment. Major Vladilena "Lena" Milizé, a noble born officer of the Alba and an outspoken critic of her government's brutal policies, is appointed as the Handler for the Spearhead Squadron an elite group of 86 soldiers known for surviving where others fall. Their commander, Shinei Nouzen call sign "Undertaker" leads a unit so notorious that every previous Handler assigned to them has either gone mad or taken their own life. As Lena builds a connection with the squad, she comes to understand the true horrors of the war and the inhumanity inflicted upon the 86. Together, she and Shinei uncover a grim reality: the war, and the Republic itself, hide secrets darker than either of them imagined. Following an untimely and embarrassing death, Kazuma Satou, a Japanese teenage shut-in NEET, meets a goddess named Aqua, who offers to reincarnate him in a parallel world with MMORPG elements, where he can go on adventures and battle monsters. Despite being offered a superpowered item or ability to use in this new world, Kazuma, following some provocation, chooses Aqua herself to accompany him to the town of Axel, quickly finding her absent-mindedness to be less than beneficial. With Aqua unable to return to the afterlife until the Devil King is defeated, the two form a party and recruit two other members; an explosion-obsessed magician named Megumin and a masochistic crusader named Darkness. Due to the party's dysfunctional abilities, Kazuma quickly gives up on the idea of defeating the Devil King and tries to live a comfortable lifestyle, only to find the circumstances of his daily life are forcing him and his party to encounter and battle the Devil King's generals.

description: Konosuba God's Blessing on This Wonderful World ! Vol.1-17 set Light Novel Japan ※Cleaned Bless This Wonderful World! (Kono Suteki Sekai ni Shuku Fuwa wo) is a Japanese light novel by Natsume Ake. It is a remake of a web novel, and was published by Kadokawa Sneaker Bunko (Kadokawa Shoten → KADOKAWA) from October 2013 to September 2023. Abbreviated as ""Konosuba. Kazuma Sato (Kazuma), a high school student who lost his life in an accident, is offered a transfer to another world by the goddess Aqua in the heavenly realm. She solicits his transfer to another world while offering him a perk: ""You can bring only one thing you want to another world. However, when Aqua makes fun of Kazuma and laughs at him, Kazuma, out of spite, designates Aqua as the ""thing to bring to the other world"" and gets her involved in the transfer. Thus, Kazuma lands in the other world of ""Axel Town"" with Aqua, and becomes an ordinary adventurer with only unusually good luck, while Aqua, with low luck and intelligence but high in all other stats, becomes an Arc Priest. Then, she joins Megumi, an arc wizard who is a master of explosive magic but cannot move after one shot, and Daknes, a masochist who looks like a beautiful woman but is delusional and a perverted crusader whose attacks never hit anything. However, the girls' problematic behavior, which knows no bounds beyond imagination, leads Kazuma into various upheavals, including trouble with the Demon Lord's army, a popularity contest with a great demon, a money fight with a villainous lord, and finally, the goddess running away from home. ※Please view photos carefully as they form part of the description Description Shipping & Customs (DDP to USA) We ship to the United States using DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). Thank you for your understanding. --------- Synopsis --------- One day, in the library where Sakuta Azusagawa studies, he runs into an unexpected sight: a beautiful high school girl in a bunny outfit. She turns out to be Mai Sakurajima, a famous former actress and fellow student at Minegahara High. His surprise at seeing Mai wear such risqué attire in the library, however, is nothing compared to the shocking realization that he is the only one who can see her! Reminded of an event from his past, Sakuta offers to help Mai discover the reason behind her invisibility. Despite their initially contentious relationship, the two quickly become close: Mai and Sakuta learn to appreciate each other, and their friendship turns into a budding romance. description:
Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai Manga Vol 1 LOOSE SET Dive into the whimsical world of "Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai" with volume 1, presented in an English translation that captures the essence of the original Japanese manga. This softcover edition, published by WOS Limited in 2015, brings to life a tale of romance, comedy, and supernatural elements that has captured the hearts of readers globally.

Authored by Hajime Kamoshida & Tsugumi Nanamiya, this comedic exploration follows the adventures of characters like Shoko Makinohara and Kaede Azusagawa as they navigate the complexities of school life and interpersonal relationships. Whether you're a long-time manga enthusiast or new to the genre, this series promises a delightful reading experience. Synopsis Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai follows the story of Sakuta Azusagawa, a high school student whose life takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Mai Sakurajima, a teenage actress dressed as a bunny girl. Strangely, no one else can see Mai, even when she is in plain sight. This phenomenon is linked to Adolescence Syndrome, a mysterious condition that manifests supernatural occurrences tied to emotional struggles. As Sakuta helps Mai uncover the reasons behind her invisibility, he becomes involved in the lives of other girls experiencing similar cases of Adolescence Syndrome. The manga explores themes of identity, relationships, and the challenges of growing up, blending heartfelt moments with humor and a touch of the supernatural. title: The Eminence In Shadow English Light Novel Vol.1-5 Full Set Original Kadokawa
description: The Eminence In Shadow English Light Novel Vol.1-5 Full Set Original Kadokawa Item Details The Eminence In Shadow Artist/Writer: Daisuke AIzawa Condition: Brand New and Sealed Language: English Version Volume: 1-5 Publisher : Kadokawa Gempak Starz Note : Suitable for collectors, 100% Original Authorized Publisher SYNOPSIS One Big Fat Lie And A Few Twisted Truths Even in his past life, Cid's dream wasn't to become a protagonist or a final boss. He'd rather lie low as a minor character until it's prime time to reveal he's a mastermind... or at least, do the next best thing - pretend to be one! And now that he's been reborn into another world, he's ready to set the perfect conditions to live out his dreams to the fullest. Armed with his overactive imagination, Cid jokingly recruits members to his organization and makes up a whole backstory about an evil cult that they need to take down. Well, as luck would have it, these imaginary adversaries turn out to be the read deal - and everyone knows the truth but him! I honestly can't remember what catalyzed this desire. All I know is I've admired shadowbrokers for as long as I can remember. Was it a certain anime? Or was it a manga - or a movie? Eh, I guess it doesn't matter. I was all in for anything that featured a mastermind, or an eminence in shadow, as I like to call them. These characters were never the protagonists or final bosses but were relegated to a role behind the scenes where they flaunted their powers and meddled in the affairs of others. I've always looked up to the men in the shadows. I wanted to be one of them. Think of children who worship their favourite superheroes. That was me but with master puppeteers. description: The Eminence In Shadow English Light Novel Vol.1-5 [Loose Set] Original Kadokawa Item Details The Eminence In Shadow Artist/Writer: Daisuke AIzawa Condition: Brand New and Sealed Language: English Version Volume: 1-5 Publisher : Kadokawa Gempak Starz Note : Suitable for collectors, 100% Original Authorized Publisher SYNOPSIS One Big Fat Lie And A Few Twisted Truths Even in his past life, Cid's dream wasn't to become a protagonist or a final boss. He'd rather lie low as a minor character until it's prime time to reveal he's a mastermind... or at least, do the next best thing - pretend to be one! And now that he's been reborn into another world, he's ready to set the perfect conditions to live out his dreams to the fullest. Armed with his overactive imagination, Cid jokingly recruits members to his organization and makes up a whole backstory about an evil cult that they need to take down. Well, as luck would have it, these imaginary adversaries turn out to be the read deal - and everyone knows the truth but him! I honestly can't remember what catalyzed this desire. All I know is I've admired shadowbrokers for as long as I can remember. Was it a certain anime? Or was it a manga - or a movie? Eh, I guess it doesn't matter. I was all in for anything that featured a mastermind, or an eminence in shadow, as I like to call them. These characters were never the protagonists or final bosses but were relegated to a role behind the scenes where they flaunted their powers and meddled in the affairs of others. I've always looked up to the men in the shadows. I wanted to be one of them. Think of children who worship their favourite superheroes. That was me but with master puppeteers. title: The Eminence In Shadow English Light Novel Vol.1-5 [Loose Set] Original Kadokawa
description: The Eminence In Shadow English Light Novel Vol.1-5 [Loose Set] Original Kadokawa Item Details The Eminence In Shadow Artist/Writer: Daisuke AIzawa Condition: Brand New and Sealed Language: English Version Volume: 1-5 Publisher : Kadokawa Gempak Starz Note : Suitable for collectors, 100% Original Authorized Publisher SYNOPSIS One Big Fat Lie And A Few Twisted Truths Even in his past life, Cid's dream wasn't to become a protagonist or a final boss. He'd rather lie low as a minor character until it's prime time to reveal he's a mastermind... or at least, do the next best thing - pretend to be one! And now that he's been reborn into another world, he's ready to set the perfect conditions to live out his dreams to the fullest. Armed with his overactive imagination, Cid jokingly recruits members to his organization and makes up a whole backstory about an evil cult that they need to take down. Well, as luck would have it, these imaginary adversaries turn out to be the read deal - and everyone knows the truth but him! I honestly can't remember what catalyzed this desire. All I know is I've admired shadowbrokers for as long as I can remember. Was it a certain anime? Or was it a manga - or a movie? Eh, I guess it doesn't matter. I was all in for anything that featured a mastermind, or an eminence in shadow, as I like to call them. These characters were never the protagonists or final bosses but were relegated to a role behind the scenes where they flaunted their powers and meddled in the affairs of others. I've always looked up to the men in the shadows. I wanted to be one of them. Think of children who worship their favourite superheroes. That was me but with master puppeteers.
